notablePrerequisites: One other creature on the battlefield.
description:
Mutate Vadrok onto the extra creature.
Use Vadrok's mutate trigger to cast chance for Glory from the graveyard, take an extra turn after this one, and gain a thopter token from Saheeli's trigger.
This token will be your mutate target next turn.
Before the end of turn, pay to activate Crystal Shard and return Vadrok to your hand.
Activate Obeka, Brute Chronologist to exile the lose the game trigger.
Repeat.
